title: Imported module is undefined in development
body:
**Describe the bug**

Importing a npm package returns undefined in development but not in production.

```
<script>
    import marked from 'marked'
    // marked is undefined
</script>
```

This bug does not seem to be isolated to `marked`. I've encountered it with `markdown-it`, `snarkdown`, and several of my own npm packages.

**Logs**

```
Cannot read property 'setOptions' of undefined

TypeError: Cannot read property 'setOptions' of undefined
    at index.svelte:5:21
    at Object.$$render (/path/to/repo/node_modules/.pnpm/svelte@3.35.0/node_modules/svelte/internal/index.js:1369:22)
    at Object.default (root.svelte:46:46)
    at /path/to/repo/.svelte/dev/components/layout.svelte:5:41
    at Object.$$render (/path/to/repo/node_modules/.pnpm/svelte@3.35.0/node_modules/svelte/internal/index.js:1369:22)
    at root.svelte:42:13
    at $$render (/path/to/repo/node_modules/.pnpm/svelte@3.35.0/node_modules/svelte/internal/index.js:1369:22)
    at Object.render (/path/to/repo/node_modules/.pnpm/svelte@3.35.0/node_modules/svelte/internal/index.js:1377:26)
    at get_response (file:///path/to/repo/node_modules/.pnpm/@sveltejs/kit@1.0.0-next.61_svelte@3.35.0+vite@2.1.3/node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/dist/ssr.js:2360:27)
    at async render_page (file:///path/to/repo/node_modules/.pnpm/@sveltejs/kit@1.0.0-next.61_svelte@3.35.0+vite@2.1.3/node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/dist/ssr.js:2472:19)
```

**To Reproduce**

Minimal reproduction (created from steps below): https://github.com/Nick-Mazuk/sveltekit-import

```
pnpm init svelte@next
pnpm i
pnpm i marked
```

Then, in the `src/routes/index.svelte` file, just add this to the `<script>` tag:

```js
import marked from 'marked'

marked.setOptions({
    smartypants: true,
})
```

```
pnpm dev
```

Then, you'll get the error when you visit the site.

_However…_

If you build the project then start the production server, everything works correctly.

```
pnpm build
pnpm start
```

**Expected behavior**
No error in development. Should get same results as in production.

**Stacktraces**
No stack trace.

**Information about your SvelteKit Installation:**

```
System:
    OS: macOS 11.2
    CPU: (16) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9880H CPU @ 2.30GHz
    Memory: 122.65 MB / 64.00 GB
    Shell: 3.2.57 - /bin/bash
  Binaries:
    Node: 12.17.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v12.17.0/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.22.10 - /usr/local/bin/yarn
    npm: 7.6.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v12.17.0/bin/npm
  Browsers:
    Brave Browser: 89.1.22.70
    Firefox: 84.0.2
    Safari: 14.0.3
  npmPackages:
    @sveltejs/kit: next => 1.0.0-next.61 
    svelte: ^3.29.0 => 3.35.0 
```

Same results on node and Vercel adapters.

**Severity**
Sever. Completely blocking development.
